backgrounds.name: lamplighter
backgrounds.blurb: Kept the wick-roads of the upper dark. Knows how far oil goes.

backgrounds.name: cutter
backgrounds.blurb: Fought in somebody's war topside. The habits came home intact.

backgrounds.name: glasspicker
backgrounds.blurb: Grew up sorting shard-middens barehanded. Fast eyes, faster fingers.
backgrounds.knack_text: +1 chit on every salvage item banked

backgrounds.name: salvage-priest
backgrounds.blurb: Ordained to speak the rites over what is brought up. Unafraid of most of it.

backgrounds.name: surgeons-runner
backgrounds.blurb: Carried the bags and held the clamps. Knows what keeps a body going.

backgrounds.name: archivist
backgrounds.blurb: Catalogued recovered writings until the writings started answering.
